definitions.coverage_pct: Unicode str.isalnum union coverage of in-scope mapped annotations, class-agnostic final mask.
definitions.excess_pct: Masked chars outside ALL source annotations / all non-annotated chars; upper bound, not adjudicated false positives.
definitions.per_label: Label gold counts; whole-row excess repeats for each supported label (non-additive).

ensemble_baseline: Probability-averaged ensemble with threshold and propagation off.
selection_rule: Highest coverage subject to same-model all-options-off baseline excess + 1.0 percentage point; ties lower excess then grid order.
